High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Stone Pile (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Dagobah, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Stone Pile _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/15QwZ6-gAGopXqOLhMN-C08QstyRqs0B2/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Stone Pile _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,512 bytes, SHA-256 <code>0fef15d4f0818a3966af09cab83bf6d7df9fb9ab89d33daf1a859948c6dfb61b</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Dagobah-L-stonepile.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. [[Category:High-res card scans]]

This is a fan print by strangewayes, not a Decipher or Players Committee card. It is listed in the card's versions list as “strangewayes print (fan re-set)” and is not shown on the Players Committee version pages (Bill, 22 November 2026).
